Name: Jonathan, Son of Saul
Summary: Son of Saul, named among Saul's sons.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:33; 1 Chronicles 9:39; 1 Chronicles 10:2: Son of Saul, named among Saul's sons.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jonathan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
